selectedWorks.name: VELORA
selectedWorks.story: Cleanliness is often sold as a chore. VELORA reframes it as a daily ritual: calm, tactile and quietly desirable. The identity pairs a disciplined typographic system with botanical geometry and a restrained palette, giving everyday hygiene the visual language of considered care.

selectedWorks.name: MIND OVER MATTER
selectedWorks.story: A personal intellectual project about the mind as a place to train, question and renew. The identity uses compressed type, sharp contrast and a single electric accent. Its visual tension is intentional: disciplined without becoming tame.

selectedWorks.name: THE COST OF CONFORMITY
selectedWorks.story: An essay becomes a visual argument. The campaign translates conformity into repetition and independent judgement into a deliberate interruption. A strict grid establishes order; oversized type, cropped forms and a disruptive signal colour challenge it without sacrificing hierarchy.
selectedWorks.principle: Break the pattern, not the logic.

selectedWorks.name: THE WEB MAVEN
selectedWorks.story: The Web Maven builds premium web systems for businesses that need more than a pretty page. Its identity is architectural and assured: graphite, warm ivory and a precise amber signal. The system balances technical clarity with a human point of view.

selectedWorks.name: TWM REALTY
selectedWorks.story: A property identity built around trust, space and considered decisions. The visual language avoids familiar real-estate shorthand in favour of editorial typography, quiet metallic accents and generous margins that let each property breathe.

selectedWorks.name: AFTER HOURS
selectedWorks.story: A night-time music series imagined as a moving signal through the city. The campaign leans into oversized condensed type, hard crops and saturated colour. Rhythm is carried by repetition, scale shifts and a deliberate sense of visual noise.

selectedWorks.name: FORM / OBJECTS
selectedWorks.story: A furniture and objects label built on the beauty of proportion. The identity borrows from architectural drawing and tactile material studies: measured lines, warm neutrals, and a strong serif that gives the objects room to speak.

selectedWorks.name: A. O. FESTUS
selectedWorks.story: A digital home for academic work, research and public scholarship. The direction respects the authority of an established academic identity while improving clarity, navigation and access to publications. The result is an editorial web system, not a generic institutional template.
selectedWorks.principle: Clarity is a form of respect.

selectedWorks.name: ORIGIN / JOURNAL
selectedWorks.story: An independent journal concept exploring where ideas, objects and culture begin. The design uses a literary serif, a flexible modular grid and documentary image treatments. It is deliberately quiet at first glance, then reveals detail through pacing and composition.

selectedWorks.name: SŌL / OLFACTIVE
selectedWorks.story: A fragrance house imagined through atmosphere rather than excess. The system draws on sculptural silhouettes, understated typography and warm mineral colour. Packaging is treated as an object of daily ritual, with proportion and material doing most of the work.
